title: Yellow Punk Warrior Kid
description: A young male character with messy blonde hair and facial scars stands in a powerful pose, wearing black and yellow armored gear with dripping yellow accents. His right fist is clenched while his left mechanical gauntlet is extended forward, set against a plain dark gradient background.
prompt: A tough young boy with messy spiky blonde hair, facial scars and stitches, wearing heavy black and bright yellow cyberpunk armor with dripping yellow details on the chest and shoulders. He has a mechanical gauntlet on his left hand covered in glowing elements and wears matching armored boots and knee pads. He stands in an aggressive stance with one fist raised, looking directly at the viewer with a confident smirk, dramatic lighting, dark background, highly detailed digital painting.
